title: Hadad the Edomite as an adversary
description: The Lord raised up Hadad the Edomite, of royal descent, as an adversary against Solomon. When David was in Edom, Joab and the army had spent six months destroying all the men in Edom. The young Hadad fled through Midian and Paran to Egypt, where Pharaoh welcomed him, gave him a house and land, and married him to the sister of Queen Takpenes. They had a son named Genubath, who grew up in Pharaoh's household. When Hadad heard that David and Joab were dead, he asked Pharaoh for permission to return to his own country.
